chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:

Six things follow the believer after his death: a child who seeks forgiveness for him, a muṣḥaf that he leaves behind, a planting that he plants, a charity of water that he causes to flow, a well that he digs, and a sunnah (prophetic tradition) that is acted upon after him.

key_terms.الْمُؤْمِنَ: The believer who receives ongoing benefit after death
key_terms.سُنَّةٌ: A practice or tradition that continues to be followed
key_terms.سِتَّةٌ: Six enduring matters mentioned in the hadith
key_terms.صَدَقَةُ مَاءٍ: A charitable provision of water benefiting others
key_terms.قَلِيبٌ: A well dug for people’s use
key_terms.مُصْحَفٌ: A written Qur'an copy left behind for continued use
key_terms.وَلَدٌ: A child who prays and seeks forgiveness for the deceased

ai.seo_question: What deeds continue to benefit a believer after death in Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that some beneficial deeds continue to bring reward to a believer after death. It highlights ongoing benefit through righteous offspring, lasting charitable works, beneficial religious legacy, and acts that continue to serve people.
